description: For a run paused at an external seat: write stage_prompt.md, a self-contained bundle a fresh subagent can act on with zero prior context, so a driving session can dispatch the stage instead of authoring it inline. Fork a subagent, give it only this file's path; take its returned deliverable back to submit_stage. A run can wait on several stages at once (`waiting` in external_prompt): pass stage to prepare another one than the first; its bundle is written to stage_prompt-<stage>.md. A stage that waits for a repair is refused (answer it with repair_reply).

stage.description: which waiting stage to bundle; defaults to the first in `waiting` that is not waiting for a repair

name: prepare_stage_prompt
